noticias.titulo: Artificial-Intelligence Stocks Pause Selloff After Nasdaq Slump - WSJ
noticias.resumo:
Investors paused a selloff in artificial-intelligence stocks after the Nasdaq notched its worst day since June in the previous session, but sentiment was muted as oil prices continued to rise. 

Futures for the tech-heavy Nasdaq inched up 0. 2%, but global AI stocks struggled to mount a significant rally.
